```{r}
#Open the library and have it read in the data set. Make sure ggplot is activated
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
mydata <- read_dta("/Users/brynswiston/Documents/Data Wrangling Library/Week 6 Homework Files/GSS 1972-2024 Cumulative/gss7224_r1.dta")
```
```{r}
library (ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#Separate out the 15 variables of interest, and then turn them into a distinct data set
my_15_vars <- c("year", "spkath", "colath", "libath", "spkrac", "colrac", "librac", "spkcom", "colcom", "libcom", "spkmil", "colmil", "libmil", "spkhomo", "colhomo", "libhomo")
```
```{r}
filtered_data <- mydata[, my_15_vars]
```

```{r}
#Filter the data by years of interest
new_filtered_data <- filtered_data |> filter(year %in% 1976:1998)
```

```{r}
#Check to make sure data was filtered correctly
table(new_filtered_data$spkath)
table(new_filtered_data$colath)
table(new_filtered_data$libath)
```


```{r}
#Recode the new filtered data as either tolerant or intolerant 
new_filtered_data <- new_filtered_data |>
  mutate(
 
    spkath_r  = case_when(spkath  == 2 ~ 1, spkath  == 1 ~ 0),
    spkrac_r  = case_when(spkrac  == 2 ~ 1, spkrac  == 1 ~ 0),
    spkcom_r  = case_when(spkcom  == 2 ~ 1, spkcom  == 1 ~ 0),
    spkmil_r  = case_when(spkmil  == 2 ~ 1, spkmil  == 1 ~ 0),
    spkhomo_r = case_when(spkhomo == 2 ~ 1, spkhomo == 1 ~ 0),

    colath_r  = case_when(colath  == 5 ~ 1, colath  == 4 ~ 0),
    colrac_r  = case_when(colrac  == 5 ~ 1, colrac  == 4 ~ 0),
    colmil_r  = case_when(colmil  == 5 ~ 1, colmil  == 4 ~ 0),
    colhomo_r = case_when(colhomo == 5 ~ 1, colhomo == 4 ~ 0),

    colcom_r  = case_when(colcom  == 4 ~ 1, colcom  == 5 ~ 0),

    libath_r  = case_when(libath  == 1 ~ 1, libath  == 2 ~ 0),
    librac_r  = case_when(librac  == 1 ~ 1, librac  == 2 ~ 0),
    libcom_r  = case_when(libcom  == 1 ~ 1, libcom  == 2 ~ 0),
    libmil_r  = case_when(libmil  == 1 ~ 1, libmil  == 2 ~ 0),
    libhomo_r = case_when(libhomo == 1 ~ 1, libhomo == 2 ~ 0)
  )
```

```{r}
#Regroup the recoded and filtered data by year. Create a line graph
new_filtered_data <- new_filtered_data |>
  mutate(intol = rowSums(across(ends_with("_r")))) |>
  filter(!is.na(intol))

yearly <- new_filtered_data |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(mean_intol = mean(intol))

ggplot(yearly, aes(x = year, y = mean_intol)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15)) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#Create a graph that combines the two
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = yearly_rac,  aes(x = year, y = mean_intol), color = "blue") +
  geom_line(data = yearly_homo, aes(x = year, y = mean_intol), color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean intolerance (0-3)") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#Create a graph that groups by year and shows the proportion of tolerance versus intolerance using previous data recoding
yearly5 <- new_filtered_data |>
  mutate(intolerant = if_else(intol > 0, 1, 0)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(prop_intol = mean(intolerant))

ggplot(yearly5, aes(x = year, y = prop_intol)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion Intolerant") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#Set aside new variables and make them into a new data set
compelvars <- c("year", "helpfulv", "trustv")
compelfiltereddata <- mydata[, compelvars]
```

```{r}
#Account for NA answers
compelfiltereddata <- compelfiltereddata |>
  mutate(
    helpfulv_f = as_factor(helpfulv),                            
    helpfulv_f = fct_na_value_to_level(helpfulv_f, level = "NA")
  )
```

```{r}
#Recode and create a line graph showing the proportion of people who identify as helpful or trustworthy over the years
compel <- compelfiltereddata |>
  mutate(
    helpful_r = case_when(helpfulv == 1 ~ 1,
                          helpfulv %in% 2:3 ~ 0),     
    trust_r   = case_when(trustv == 1 ~ 1,            
                          trustv %in% 2:3 ~ 0)    
  )

yearly_compel <- compel |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    Helpful = mean(helpful_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    Trust   = mean(trust_r,   na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "measure", values_to = "proportion") |>
  filter(!is.nan(proportion))     

ggplot(yearly_compel, aes(x = year, y = proportion, linetype = measure)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", linetype = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
```
